text:
anya: spinning up polySim-v1 on staging (short-multilang holdout). quick eval shows recall@10 ~-6.1% vs maestro-embed for queries <=8 tokens. anyone seen this with new quant profiles?
mike: :eyes: saw a similar regression when we tried int6 per-channel on another family. was that export -> onnx -> quantize_ptq?
anya: yep. onnx-export then per-channel int6 PTQ. i also tried int8 per-tensor and int8 per-channel; int8-perchannel narrows gap to ~-2.5%.
kevin: can you paste eval command + dataset slice?
anya: sure:
```bash
python eval_embeddings.py --model polySim-v1 --quant int6-pc --dataset short-multilang-holdout --metric recall@10 --batch 256
```
anya: dataset ~12k queries (en/es/pt/zh), median len 5 tokens.
jules: check tokenizer hashes between export and serving, and verify kv-cache alignment. microbatching mismatch can subtly change outputs.
mike: also look at cosine histograms vs maestro. distribution shift often explains recall drops.
anya: export tokenizer hash == model hash. kv-cache trace looks ok but i'll dump tokenizations for a few examples.
anya: tokenizations sample:
"¿Dónde está": [694, 12, 345]
"Where is": [64, 11]
ops-bot: Started job embed-umap-1758882000 (staging/polySim-v1/int6) — will post results when done.
anya: requested cosine hist + silhouette + l2 norm hist.
ops-bot: embed-umap-1758882000 finished. posting summary:
- silhouette: maestro 0.48 -> polySim-v1 int6 0.36
- UMAP: clusters more collapsed; some neighbors merged
- L2 norms (mean,std): maestro 1.02,0.12 ; polySim-v1 int6 0.90,0.08 ; polySim-v1 int8-pc 1.01,0.11
mike: that smells like scale compression from int6 quant. lower norm + lower variance -> recall down for short queries.
kevin: try centering/normalizing before index build and compare. if recall recovers, it's a norm shift. also try per-channel int8 symmetric clipping calibration.
jules: another quick test: build a small index with maestro vectors but query with polySim int6 — if recall still bad, vectors changed relative geometry.
anya: scheduling runs: 1) int6 + post-quant L2 rescale (per-dim/global) 2) int8-perchannel symmetric MSE clip 3) int6 with rounding-aware calibration. ETA ~2h.
mike: if rescale works, we can ship a short-term runtime shim that rescales embeddings for short queries until upstream is fixed.
kevin: add a small unit test in eval harness to check l2 mean/std and silhouette so this doesn't regress silently.
anya: added ticket draft and will paste plots + scripts when runs finish.
jules: also double-check index similarity metric (cosine vs inner product) and ensure index build uses same normalization pipeline as eval harness. mismatch there has burned us before.
ops-bot: Note: scheduling fallback policy check for dedicated pools when onboarding models. polySim-v1 flagged if recall@10 delta > 4% vs baseline.
anya: tagging eng-platform for rollout fallback / canary rules. will post results in thread. thanks all :heart:
